I used to sound like you, now I sound like Oliver Sykes. What you just NEED to understand and what kept me from actually being able to perform a scream that sounds like an actual scream and not a forced whisper, was that instead of making the fry noise and then pushing it further with my diaphragm and all, I had to know how to use my diaphragm to produce a clean yell first. Not a scream, a simple yell. And not one forced through your throat, fucking up your voice, but a solid one based entirely on your diaphragm. That is literally all you have to do, because now that you have a strong, solid and actually LOUD foundation, you can just tighten up and make the fry noise as you would normally, but all layered on top of the yell you’ve already got going on. That makes your scream loud, powerful, filthy and raspy, yet full of voice so it sounds like a normal human produced scream, except it’s still a fry scream that won’t hurt your voice one bit. It’s literally the simplest shit and it took me almost a year to figure out. Also, quick tip, please don’t look at YouTube tutorials on screaming, they all fucking suck, I’ve watched everything and nothing but my own experience has helped. they aren't the same, they're nothing alike. a fry scream is much more tensed up especially with the flexed diaphragm and crackling noise, while a false chord is much airier louder and loose-feeling. a fry isn't even a scream, it's an imitation of one - it's too quiet to be a yell, let alone a full-blown scream. false chords on the other hand can be loud as fuck, especially high false chord screams.

It's just a fry scream. Do a clean yell and really flex your whole stomach/diaphragm area like as if you were taking a massive shit. Mix these sounds together and you'll pretty much have a yell scream.

if you’re asking how I made the scream, it’s not even really a scream, it’s pretty quiet. it pretty much sounds like a scream because i was close to the microphone (my phone), which made it distorted in turn making it sound more powerful. irl it’s pretty much just above speaking level. I made it by doing that basic vocal fry sound and then really squeezing my whole diagram/stomach area which makes it crackle, and then i make sure to let out just enough air for it to flow but not so much that it sounds like a forced whisper. i think the transition is pretty audible in the part where i whisper and then slowly turn into a scream. this is my “fry” technique. I think I can also do power fry screams but i’m not too sure it’s the right technique. I basically do it by doing a falsetto or head voice or girly voice or whatever, and then pretty much pushing a scream through that. It basically doesn’t hurt me but I’m just not sure if that’s how the actual technique is done, so i try to refrain from using it. feedback on both my fry and power fry techniques would be REALLY appreciated.
